task_instance: User shares an arXiv ID (2501.12948, the DeepSeek-R1 paper) and asks to summarize it and list its linked models/datasets/GitHub repo. Attempted the skill's core flow: fetch https://huggingface.co/papers/2501.12948.md (paper page as markdown), https://huggingface.co/api/papers/2501.12948 (structured metadata: authors, project page, github repo), and the arXiv abstract as a fallback.
blocker_detail: WebFetch is blocked by the sandbox's network egress proxy for every domain the skill needs: https://huggingface.co/papers/2501.12948.md, https://huggingface.co/api/papers/2501.12948, https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12948, and even the ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org HTML mirror all returned {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED", ...}. A control fetch to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek was also EGRESS_BLOCKED, indicating WebFetch cannot reach any external domain in this runtime, not just huggingface.co/arxiv.org specifically. The only working web tool, WebSearch, returns short third-party snippets (title + a paraphrased abstract sentence pulled from search-result text) rather than the actual paper-page markdown or the structured JSON (authors with HF usernames, linked models/datasets/spaces, GitHub repo, project page, upvotes) that is the skill's actual deliverable. Since no shell/curl and no code execution are permitted either, there is no way in this runtime to retrieve the real content the skill is built around.
evidence: WebFetch(https://huggingface.co/papers/2501.12948.md) -> EGRESS_BLOCKED (domain huggingface.co). WebFetch(https://huggingface.co/api/papers/2501.12948) -> EGRESS_BLOCKED (domain huggingface.co). WebFetch(https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12948) -> EGRESS_BLOCKED (domain arxiv.org). WebFetch(https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2501.12948) -> EGRESS_BLOCKED (domain ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org). WebFetch(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek) -> EGRESS_BLOCKED (domain en.wikipedia.org), confirming the block is not specific to Hugging Face/arXiv. WebSearch('DeepSeek-R1 paper arxiv 2501.12948 abstract') succeeded and returned links plus a short paraphrased abstract, but no access to the actual .md page, the /api/papers JSON metadata, or the linked-models/datasets/spaces endpoints the skill relies on. No result file/deliverable (paper summary with verified structured metadata) could be produced or verified beyond generic search snippets.
